ops.title: Migrate fleet stores to cc-transcript v14.2 composition (cc-steer async→sync, captain-hook ReviewStore)
ops.description:
The store tier went native in v14.2 (see notes 327358814e25 and dea97e9da1e5): mining.FeedbackStore is a final composition facade over the Rust FeedbackEngine, configured by a frozen StoreSchema; FileStateStore and VerdictStoreMixin are deleted; record_verdict is sync. Downstream rewrites (both repos' pre-migration shapes verified during planning):

- cc-steer (only pre-v14.2 store consumer, still on v13-era ASYNC idioms): async→sync AND subclass→composition in one pass. TRIAGE_DDL dies (the engine renders the verdict table from StoreSchema verdict_table='triage', accepted_column='is_steering', summary_column='what_claude_did'); its DROP+CREATE views → StoreSchema.extra_ddl (runs every non-readonly open); quarantine policy on facade primitives inside one transaction; event_filter="e.quarantined_reason IS NULL" replaces the query forks; aiosqlite dropped; +origin_path/+quarantined_reason via StoreSchema.event_columns. The paged unjudged OFFSET loop is now the platform implementation — delete cc-steer's copy. Its two CallableReviewFormat callables stay (kept in-platform, see the rulings note).
- captain-hook (already v14-sync): ReviewStore holds db: FeedbackStore + versions; its 6 extra tables → extra_ddl; its precheck+BEGIN IMMEDIATE+ALTER+backfill migrations → StoreSchema.migrations (now a platform mechanism); mechanical conn.execute→db.sql sweep (rows become dicts — watch Row-specific access). Also drop its HeartbeatLog.events_seen test usage (the accessor was deleted in v14.2).
- Fleet test cleanup: cc-steer tests/test_formats.py consumers of the deleted regex_review_comments/group_value/int_group reference path.

Contract safety net: tests/test_store_contract.py in cc-transcript pins the behaviors both repos rely on, including the refresh_summary limit=0 platform/steer divergence. Pin >=14.2,<15 after the v14.2 release.

ops.text: cc-steer: PyPI pin >=14.2,<15; store.py on StoreSchema composition, sync API, aiosqlite dropped; ty + pytest green; CI green on main
captain-hook: pin >=14.2,<15; ReviewStore composes FeedbackStore via StoreSchema (extra_ddl + migrations); suite + uvx capt-hook test green; released
cc-steer tests/test_formats.py no longer references regex_review_comments/group_value/int_group; captain-hook drops the events_seen test usage
